gaps.detail: Installed schema-2 base does not embed the paid-submit technical switch; zero-cost use is policy-only until the new Candidate is verified and atomically installed.
Development must not replace the current base. Final Candidate must pass acceptance, then atomically replace the single authoritative App path.
Desktop helper, token path, issue bridge and ChatGPT read-tool environment require one packaged-App runtime replay.
Remote resource metadata can be retained without credentials; only referenced local resource files are physically copied. No external fetch occurs during enablement.

User/provider-global logical models, revisions, prompt templates, channels, pricing and external provider bindings are cleared from the Pilot copy. Only workflow template versions referenced by the selected project are retained; candidate runtime must rediscover approved local catalogs rather than silently copy global provider state.
The single portal is mounted once and route-aware; final App still needs visual checks across global, project, canvas, Agent, Composer and error surfaces.
